name: SCANIA Component X Dataset
summary: Real-world operational readouts, repair records, and specifications for an anonymized engine component across more than 33,000 SCANIA heavy-duty trucks, released for the IDA 2024 Industrial Challenge.

availability.access: Direct per-file CSV downloads from Researchdata.se (~1.65 GB; no account required)

characteristics.kind: Fleet-scale irregular multivariate time series with repair records

feature_dimensions.summary: 105 operational features from 14 anonymized variables, plus 8 categorical specifications
feature_dimensions.counting: Readout files have 107 columns: vehicle_id, time_step, 8 numerical counters (171_0, 666_0, 427_0, 837_0, 309_0, 835_0, 370_0, 100_0), and 6 histograms with 10 (167), 10 (272), 11 (291), 10 (158), 20 (459), and 36 (397) bins. Specification files add Spec_0 to Spec_7 per vehicle.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Anonymized truck identifier; train, validation, and test vehicles are disjoint.

attributes.name: time_step
attributes.description: Anonymized operating time since Component X started working; readouts are irregular per vehicle.
Histogram bins named variableid_binindex (10, 10, 11, 10, 20, and 36 bins); outer bins are open-ended.

attributes.name: length_of_study_time_step
attributes.description: Train only: time of the first Component X repair, or end of observation when censored.

attributes.name: in_study_repair
attributes.description: Train only: 1 if Component X was repaired at length_of_study_time_step, 0 if right-censored.

attributes.name: class_label
attributes.description: Validation/test only: time window of the last readout before repair: 0 (>48), 1 (48–24), 2 (24–12), 3 (12–6), 4 (6–0) time steps.

notes: Train readouts cover each vehicle's full study period; validation and test readouts are truncated at a randomly selected last readout, and labels refer to that last readout.
About 9.6% of training vehicles (2,272 of 23,550) have a repair event; the rest are right-censored. Validation and test labels are strongly skewed toward class 0.
Timestamps, readout frequencies, and repair frequencies were anonymized and may not reflect actual truck usage. Variable names are anonymized IDs.
Fewer than 1% of values per readout feature are missing; loaders keep them as null.

Downloads use the nine CSVs of version 3 (DOI 10.5878/bnh5-ka77), verify each SND-published SHA-256, and bundle them locally. Data files are identical to version 2 (DOI 10.5878/jvb5-d390), which the Scientific Data paper cites.
Expect about 3.3 GB on disk after extraction (local bundle plus extracted CSVs).
citation: Z. Kharazian, T. Lindgren, S. Magnússon, O. Steinert and O. Andersson Reyna (2025). SCANIA Component X dataset: a real-world multivariate time series dataset for predictive maintenance. Scientific Data, 12, 493. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04802-6
